interview_pilot.cohort: Yaris Cross Hybrid service due, with verified paid or mixed eligibility for the commercial endpoint
interview_pilot.design_summary: Normal WhatsApp or assisted service in both groups; add the Digiroom work and delegated approval record in the pilot group.
interview_pilot.primary_endpoint: Completed customer-paid work orders per eligible paid or mixed opportunity
interview_pilot.economic_input_policy: Interview cases do not populate financial or adoption inputs.

workbook_rows.decision: Yaris Cross Hybrid service record at Auto2000 Soekarno-Hatta, Bandung. Setiabudi is the fallback.
workbook_rows.boundary: Branch capacity, paid/mixed eligibility and ownership require confirmation.

workbook_rows.decision: Keep WhatsApp booking; add accepted scope, coverage, approval and completion status in Digiroom.
workbook_rows.boundary: Make delegated approval revocable. Maintain assisted access.

workbook_rows.decision: Compare usual workflow with usual workflow plus the record. Assign eligible households or comparable branch weeks where feasible.
workbook_rows.boundary: Record capacity and contamination. Use descriptive results if comparison is weak.

workbook_rows.decision: Completed paid work orders per eligible paid or mixed opportunity. Include actual recognized contribution.
workbook_rows.boundary: Track covered service separately. Count one work order across channels.

workbook_rows.decision: Voluntary return for status, approval, completion or a later distinct ownership task.
workbook_rows.boundary: Track repeat work, rework, authorization time and service effort.

workbook_rows.decision: Confirmed xEV demonstration and inspected net-upgrade offer. Compare funding mechanisms later.
workbook_rows.boundary: The interviews supply no conversion, uplift or realized price-floor effect.

insights.headline: Existing eligible channels remove19 of39 modeled oil-access tails
insights.evidence_basis: 284 strict paired origins; corrected coordinates; job-fit/operator scenario
insights.recommended_decision: Build eligible owned-channel routing and target residual-access tests
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Uniform four-market pickup or capacity expansion

insights.headline: Oil substitution and general-workshop preservation imply different branch choices
insights.inference_boundary: Job-specific substitution is distinct from general-workshop network geometry
insights.recommended_decision: Protect general-workshop availability while routing eligible routine work
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Treating zero oil tails as general-workshop redundancy

insights.headline: Soekarno-Hatta combines residual access with reported return-visit mechanisms
insights.evidence_basis: Eight residual model origins plus selected M08/M09 accounts | Interview update: The HEV interview branch is undisclosed.
insights.inference_boundary: Selected accounts do not estimate failure prevalence
insights.recommended_decision: Add approved scope and the driver-to-approver handoff to the preparedness test; verify the actual branch cohort.

insights.headline: Intended paid service can be lost at acknowledgement
insights.evidence_basis: M01explicitpaidVelozarrival;M03walk-inqueue;M02historicalunnamedapp | Interview update: The interviews supply successful routine comparators, not a measured failure rate.
insights.inference_boundary: Not a network failure rate or proof of current Digiroom defect
insights.recommended_decision: Keep successful WhatsApp entry and test all-channel acknowledgement and closure in a defined cohort.
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Acquisition or app-install campaigns before reception control

insights.headline: Repair retention can compete with vehicle replacement
insights.inference_boundary: BundledRp25m is not verified Auto2000 invoice; repair equivalence unknown
insights.recommended_decision: Offer retain/repair/replace alternatives and count outcomes once
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Counting immediate repair and immediate replacement as additive for one owner

insights.headline: Toyota HEV continuity and BEV acquisition require different task paths
insights.evidence_basis: Case mostly hybrid; external modelmix; YouTubeBYD/Neta sample | Interview update: The cases contrast fixed residential charging and low-charge travel adaptations.
insights.inference_boundary: External hybrid denominator differs from caseToyotaEVestimate
insights.recommended_decision: Lead HEV ownership with relevant tasks and offer route/fallback support to BEV households where charging conditions warrant it.
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Using selected BEV resale discourse as Toyota-owner demand prevalence

insights.headline: Entitlement timing limits near-horizon paid routine-service claims
insights.evidence_type: Programme terms and conditional calendar model
insights.evidence_basis: Sevencoveredtime-basedevents;month42example;paidXTRAconditions | Interview update: The reported covered service does not establish customer-paid work.
insights.inference_boundary: Mileage and uncovered work differ; not a BEV schedule forecast
insights.recommended_decision: Track covered, reimbursed and customer-paid work separately; validate paid or mixed HEV opportunities at the branch.

insights.headline: Accepted evidence must lead to an executable net-upgrade offer
insights.evidence_basis: ExistingHHC/tradein;TRIVAreviewmentionsM19/M20;finance/settlement dependencies | Interview update: Actual research ended at an indicative price range; a stated floor preference does not establish a purchase response.
insights.inference_boundary: Not a validated battery premium or universal residual guarantee
insights.recommended_decision: Test an inspected written net-upgrade offer; treat top-up and full-floor choices as separate later commercial tests.
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Another detached certificate or speculative universal price floor

insights.headline: A confirmed household-relevant demonstration addresses an acquisition obstruction
insights.evidence_basis: SX02unitavailabilityaccount;M15/M16hybridpurchase;SY02installationcash | Interview update: No interview documents a new-to-Auto2000 delivery or a failed demonstration.
insights.inference_boundary: No national demonstrator shortage or measured sales uplift established
insights.recommended_decision: Confirm the demonstrator and test driver needs and household buyer authority separately before the executable offer.
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Generic education as substitute for attendable matched demonstration

insights.headline: All-channel incremental recognized contribution is the relevant profit bridge
insights.evidence_basis: Case84%bookingsoutsideapp;operatorandpayerperimeter | Interview update: Routine WhatsApp bookings already closed in two accounts; repeated digital use is a testable hypothesis.
insights.inference_boundary: Channel migration and ecosystem capture are distinct from incrementalAuto2000GP
insights.recommended_decision: Measure incremental completion and payer-specific contribution against normal service, alongside useful digital return.
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Adding appbookings, referrals and hypothetical future purchases as newGP

insights.headline: A driver can run the service visit while a different family member controls added spend
insights.evidence_type: Interview self-reports, elicited concept and cross-source pilot hypothesis
insights.evidence_basis: Wuling driver approves and pays before reimbursement; Yaris driver runs service while father approves paid extra work. Yaris driver interested in a work record. M08/M09 describe scope/return problems at a different branch.
insights.inference_boundary: The interview cases establish roles and current channel sufficiency. Pilot branch eligibility, app use and commercial effect remain to be measured.
insights.recommended_decision: Test a Digiroom service and approval record alongside WhatsApp with Yaris Cross Hybrid owners at Auto2000 Soekarno-Hatta, conditional on branch readiness.
insights.lower_priority_alternative: Compulsory app booking or an upfront resale guarantee as the first pilot
